WITH status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    CENTROMEA,
    AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) as avg_got_gpt,
    AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT END) as avg_appt_pt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE WBC > 6.5
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_got_gpt) as overall_avg_got_gpt,
  AVG(avg_appt_pt) as overall_avg_appt_pt
FROM status_avgs
